tasks.sql: SELECT e.lastName || ", " || e.firstName AS Empleado, ROUND(SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS Ventas_USD FROM orders AS o JOIN employees AS e ON o.employeeID = e.employeeID JOIN order_details AS od ON o.orderID = od.orderID GROUP BY Empleado ORDER BY Ventas_USD DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.categoryName AS Categoria, ROUND(SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS Ventas_USD FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.categoryID = p.categoryID JOIN order_details AS od ON p.productID = od.productID GROUP BY Categoria ORDER BY Ventas_USD DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ar.Name AS Artista, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS Canciones FROM Artist AS ar JOIN Album AS al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track AS t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY Artista ORDER BY Canciones DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT c.Country AS Pais, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS Facturacion_USD FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY Pais ORDER BY Facturacion_USD DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS Actor, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS Peliculas FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY Actor ORDER BY Peliculas DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT n.n_name AS Pais, COUNT(c.c_custkey) AS Clientes FROM customer AS c JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY Pais ORDER BY Clientes DESC LIMIT 10
